run_election_with_elo_voting: run an election using EloVoting to rank alternatives from a preference profile
compute_ratings_from_preference_profile: compute Elo ratings from a preference profile with configurable smoothing and convergence parameters
create_elo_voting_instance: create an EloVoting instance with custom smoothing factor, max iterations, and convergence delta
get_elo_voting_name: get the name string of an EloVoting voting method instance
rank_alternatives_by_elo: rank alternatives by Elo ratings sorted in descending order from a preference profile
